title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Restricted Personnel
tiers.description: The Board, the CEO, the Manager - Exploration and Development, the CFO, and anyone else who is an Employee of, or Consultant to, Horizon Oil or its subsidiaries whose position exposes or is likely to expose them to Inside Information.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Members of the Board; distinguished from other Restricted Personnel only for the Nominated Representative for notification purposes (Chairman) and for the ASX Appendix 3X/3Y/3Z shareholding notification duty.

tiers.name: Associated parties
tiers.description: Immediate family including a spouse (or equivalent) or dependent, and any family company or trust of a member of Restricted Personnel; must comply with the same restrictions as the Restricted Personnel they are associated with.

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board of Horizon Oil has absolute discretion to place an embargo on Restricted Personnel and/or employees and/or their associated parties trading in Horizon Oil securities at any time; confidentiality of such an embargo is not addressed.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on dealing in any financial derivative, including options, relating to Horizon Oil securities, with no venue limit and no distinction by vesting status; the definition of Securities separately confirms coverage of third-party-issued derivatives and OTC-style risk-limiting products.
rules.evidence: Restricted Personnel must not enter into a hedging arrangement, deal in a financial derivative (including options) or enter into any other arrangement to protect against or limit the risk associated with a holding of Horizon Oil securities.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging arrangements and any other arrangement to protect against or limit the risk of a Horizon Oil securities holding; no vesting or clearance carve-out.
rules.evidence: Restricted Personnel must not enter into a hedging arrangement, deal in a financial derivative (including options) or enter into any other arrangement to protect against or limit the risk associated with a holding of Horizon Oil securities.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named, but a prepaid forward or similar structure would be 'any other arrangement to protect against or limit the risk' of a securities holding and so is caught by the section 9 ban.
rules.evidence: or enter into any other arrangement to protect against or limit the risk associated with a holding of Horizon Oil securities.

rules.detail: Short selling is not named or otherwise addressed.
Securities lending is not named or otherwise addressed.
CFDs are not named but are a 'financial derivative' and so are caught by the section 9 ban on dealing in any financial derivative relating to Horizon Oil securities.
rules.evidence: deal in a financial derivative (including options)

rules.detail: Margin lending is not named or otherwise addressed anywhere in the policy.
Granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over Horizon Oil securities is not named and is not swept in by the 'Dealing' definition (applying for, acquiring or disposing, or agreeing to do so).
No provision addresses secured financing arrangements of any kind in respect of Horizon Oil securities.

General prohibition at all times on purchase and sale of the same securities within a six month period, with limited exceptions for exercising ESOP options, redemption of securities, or certain other option exercises.
rules.evidence: Restricted Personnel are generally prohibited from short-term trading at all times.  Short-term trading is a purchase and sale of the same securities within a six month period.

exceptions.evidence: The Board may, in exceptional circumstances only, approve any member of Restricted Personnel or his or her associated parties trading in Horizon Oil securities during an embargo period.

This embargo on short term trading may be excepted in some very limited circumstances for example, exercising options in employee share ownership plans, redemption of securities or certain other option exercises.

exemption_authority: The Board may, in exceptional circumstances only, approve a member of Restricted Personnel or their associated parties trading during an embargo period, but will not grant an exemption if it considers undisclosed information exists that would be likely to materially affect the price if it were generally available. The Board separately has absolute discretion to impose an embargo at any time.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Personnel must not enter into a hedging arrangement, deal in a financial derivative (including options) or enter into any other arrangement to protect against or limit the risk associated with a holding of Horizon Oil securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is an unqualified, venue-neutral ban on derivatives dealing that applies to every tier and every security state with no clearance route, so an OTC put/call collar with a bank cannot be entered under any circumstances envisaged by the policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: "Securities" include shares, derivatives and other financial products that can be traded on a financial market including financial products issued or created over Horizon Oil securities by third parties and products which operate to limit economic risk in securities holdings in Horizon Oil.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Confirms a bank-issued OTC collar is squarely within scope of the section 9 ban, not merely an ancillary dealing caught incidentally.

bespoke_clauses.clause: (no clause addresses margin loans, secured financing or encumbrance)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg secured on the collared shares has no express treatment; absent the section 9 ban, it would fall back on the general dealing and notification rules as an ordinary transaction, but the point is moot given derivatives are already prohibited.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The Directors of Horizon Oil are required to complete either Appendix 3X, 3Y or 3Z (as applicable) and provide it to Horizon Oil to be filed with the ASX in respect of their shareholding.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any change in a director's economic interest, such as one arising from an approved collar or loan, would still require ASX notification via these forms independent of the internal clearance process.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The Board of Horizon Oil have an absolute discretion to place an embargo on Restricted Personnel and / or employees and / or their respective associated parties trading in Horizon Oil securities at any time.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even if a derivatives exemption were somehow granted, the Board can impose an unscheduled embargo at any time, adding execution timing risk to any collar structure.

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy. Section 9 imposes an absolute, unconditional ban on Restricted Personnel (and their associated parties, including directors and employees) entering any hedging arrangement or dealing in any financial derivative, including options, relating to Horizon Oil securities, with no distinction by vesting status, no venue carve-out, and no clearance or exemption route directed at derivatives specifically. The policy's own definition of 'Securities' expressly extends to third-party-issued and risk-limiting financial products, confirming an OTC bank collar falls within the ban. The loan leg is not separately addressed at all: margin lending, secured financing and encumbrance are silent, so it would fall back on the general notification regime (three days' prior written notice to the Chairman for directors or the Company Secretary for others, plus post-trade confirmation) if it were otherwise permissible, but that is moot given the derivatives ban. The Board's exceptional-circumstances exemption applies only to trading during the twice-yearly embargo periods and does not touch the section 9 derivatives prohibition, so no combination of consents under this policy would permit the structure.
